resources.string: Cheat sheet
Type your message like you would send it. Where a word should change, tap “Add something that changes” and pick a kind. This is what each kind does.
What each kind does
What can each kind do?
Cheat sheet
What each kind of changing word can do.
On the keyboard
Good for
Example
A list of answers
Your answers are tiles. Tap one.
The one you used last is first, with a ★.
Need a new answer? Tap “+ New”, type it in the app, then go back to your message.
Names, medicines, doses, places.
Who? Sam or Alex
A time
Tiles: Now (with the time), 15 min ago, 30 min ago, 1 hour ago.
“Other” lets you move the time, 5 minutes or 1 hour at a time.
A later time: add a time, then choose “After another time”. For example “4 hours after When”. The keyboard works it out, even past midnight.
When a medicine was given. When you will arrive.
Given at 20:20. Next dose not before 00:20.
A time from now
Pick “A time”, then “From now”, then Mins, Hours or Days, then type a number, like 10.
One amount: it is always used and the keyboard never asks.
Two or more amounts: the keyboard shows them as tiles, plus “Other”.
You choose what the message shows: the amount (10 mins), the time (20:35), or both (10 mins (20:35)).
“Be there in…”. “Back at…”. A next dose.
Be there in 10 mins. Or: Be there at 20:35.
A time ago
The same steps as “From now”, but it counts back from now.
Show the amount (20 mins), the time it was (20:00), or both.
“Given…”. “It started…”.
Given 20 mins ago. Or: Given at 20:00.
A date
Tiles: Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow.
“Other” moves the date one day at a time.
Appointments. The day something happened.
Appointment on 19 Oct 2026
A number
A number pad, with a dot for things like 2.5.
It remembers the last number you used.
Only the number changes. Words next to it stay, like the “ml” in 5ml.
Amounts and counts.
How many? 5, then “ml” stays
Words you type
Everything you type stays exactly as you wrote it, every time. Only the chips change.
Good to know
The name you give a changing part is the question the keyboard asks. Keep it short, like “Who?” or “When?”.
You can change a shortcut any time. Open it and tap “Edit shortcut”.
Nothing to change in a message? That is fine. The keyboard just adds it.
